page.content:
Shakespeare's wife, married in Stratford upon Avon.

How Anne Hathaway connects

  • Creator: William Shakespeare — Anne Hathaway was William Shakespeare's wife.
  • Location: Stratford-upon-Avon — Anne Hathaway kept the Stratford household.

What is Anne Hathaway?

Anne Hathaway of Shottery married William Shakespeare in 1582 and kept a household in Stratford while he worked the London stages and the Globe.

Key threads lead to William Shakespeare and Stratford-upon-Avon.
